body_edits.new:
A worked example from our [published citation study](/research/studies/who-ai-engines-cite/) is: 39 of 2,095 eligible target answers captured on 22 and 23 September 2026 had empty supplied citation lists, 1.9%, with a descriptive 95% Wilson interval of 1.4% to 2.5%. The [answer-base table](/research/data/answer-citation-bases.csv) makes the unit and denominator recoverable. This sentence illustrates how to report our own count; it does not show that this writing format earns a citation, or that those answers used no underlying sources.

**Suggests:** Follow-up within the stated setting.
**Write a supported answer whose evidence, date and counted unit remain clear when the passage is read alone.**
body_edits.old: **GEO’s best tested methods improved position-adjusted word-count visibility by 41%, not citation probability (Aggarwal et al., 2024, Table 1).**

body_edits.new: Aggarwal and colleagues tested statistics, quotations and source citations in an experimental answer system using position-adjusted word-count visibility and subjective impressions. Those measures are not the probability that an AI engine will cite a newly published B2B page. [Aggarwal et al., 2024, Table 1 and §4](https://arxiv.org/html/2311.09735v3).
body_edits.old: **41%** is a result about a particular visibility metric in a particular experiment. It is not the probability that an AI engine will cite your next article. Aggarwal and colleagues report that the best tested methods improved position-adjusted word-count visibility by 41% and subjective impression by 28% against their benchmark baseline. The tested changes included statistics, quotations and source citations. [Aggarwal et al., 2024, Table 1 and §4](https://arxiv.org/html/2311.09735v3).

body_edits.new: The paper’s main result and five-seed appendix do not report the same estimates. We treat that headline as fragile rather than adopting it as a publishing effect. The paper also examines a deployed system, where results vary by method. Neither setting establishes a universal performance promise for a B2B page.
body_edits.old: That is a useful reason to make evidence legible. It is not permission to attach an impressive number to a vague claim. The paper uses an experimental answer system and separately examines a deployed system; results depend on the metric, domain and method. Neither setting establishes a universal performance promise for a B2B product page published today.
